pages.title: Moon League Sports Season
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Moon League Sports Season prepares three monster friends for a lunar sporting championship. Choose sports clothing, hairstyles, and makeup for the different events, including the opening ceremony. Build a collection of competition looks and take a keepsake picture after finishing the styling.

pages.title: Hexa Arrows Puzzle
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Hexa Arrows Puzzle asks you to remove every hexagonal tile from a board. Tap a piece to send it in its arrow's direction, making sure another hexagon is not blocking the path. Plan the release order to dismantle the arrangement without getting stuck.

pages.title: HexaFill
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: HexaFill challenges you to fill a hexagonal grid using connected paths. Drag from the starting points and plan routes that cover the cells without overlapping or leaving dead ends. Complete the whole arrangement by keeping enough space for each remaining connection.

pages.title: Jump Master
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Jump Master asks you to time jumps between separate footholds. Press down on the marker to prepare a longer leap, then release when the distance seems right. Reach the next platform without dropping into the gap and build a stronger points total.

pages.title: Sausage Man Shooting Adventure
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Sausage Man Shooting Adventure sends an armed sausage hero through a side-scrolling battle. Run forward, jump platforms, and dodge traps while shooting the enemies in the way. Collect airdrops during the journey to strengthen the character for the waves ahead.

pages.title: Steal Brainrot Eggs
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Steal Brainrot Eggs combines collecting with raids against rival bases. Buy eggs from the central conveyor, carry them home, and hatch income-producing characters. Use the coins for rarer eggs while defending your base or stealing from opponents in one- or two-player modes.

pages.title: Pyramid Jewels
pages.creator: BlackMoon Design
pages.description: Pyramid Jewels is a gem-shooting puzzle with an ancient Egyptian setting. Aim at jewels sharing the current shot's color and release to clear matching groups. Work through the board by choosing trajectories that remove more gems and open the next part of the puzzle.

pages.title: Mind Games: Math Crosswords
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Mind Games: Math Crosswords asks you to complete intersecting equations with the candidate numbers provided. Fill each empty space so the arithmetic works in both directions. Solve simpler equations first and use hints when needed as the story links your answers to restoring planetary life.

pages.title: Screw Spin
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Screw Spin challenges you to remove colored bolts from panels and sort them into matching containers. Tap an accessible bolt to send it into the right box or a temporary slot. Keep the limited reserve from filling while clearing every fastener from the panel.

pages.title: Foxy Eco Sort
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Foxy Eco Sort follows Foxy and Raccoon cleaning polluted locations and investigating Ratty's plans. Sort waste into material categories, solve match-three puzzles, and find matching pairs. Complete story chapters involving garbage trucks and arsonists as the animals work to save their forest.

pages.title: Big Head
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Big Head is a maze puzzle about guiding a character along a safe route to the goal. Drag through the passages while watching for traps and blocked paths, working out which turns allow the character to reach the destination.

pages.title: Skate Hooligans
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Skate Hooligans sends a young skateboarder away from a pursuing policeman. Change lanes, jump, or slide to pass the obstacles while collecting coins and bonuses. Complete tasks for points and spend earnings on new boards or characters for the next escape attempt.

pages.title: Anime Doll - DIY Cosplay Girl
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Anime Doll - DIY Cosplay Girl gives you a wardrobe for creating an anime character's appearance. Try costumes, everyday clothing, and accessories in different combinations. Put together a complete cosplay-inspired look as you explore the dress-up options available for the doll.

pages.title: Bubble Rush
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Bubble Rush surrounds you with bubbles that advance after the available shots are used. Fire matching groups of at least three to clear them. Empty one side completely to stop further bubbles entering from that direction and reduce the pressure on the remaining field.

pages.title: Gun Rush
pages.creator: Digital Oddities
pages.description: Gun Rush uses gunfire to move the weapon through a level. Tap, click, or press Enter to shoot, sending it in the opposite direction through recoil. Reach the end of the route and gather coins to unlock more guns for later stages.

pages.title: 9 Blocks
pages.creator: SunStar Co.
pages.description: 9 Blocks challenges you to combine partially filled chips into a complete one. Rotate the pieces and drag neighboring chips together so their occupied squares fill the empty spaces. Plan the arrangement to produce a fully filled chip through the available merges.

pages.title: Palkovil The Way Home
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Palkovil The Way Home follows a holiday quest to bring a Christmas tree back home. Explore rooms, battle monsters, collect toys, and solve problems along the way. Switch on laboratory lights to open routes while stopping aliens from spoiling the New Year celebration.

pages.title: Wonders of Egypt Mahjong
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Wonders of Egypt Mahjong gives you forty Egyptian-themed tile layouts and three smaller tutorials. Remove identical pairs that have a free side until the board is empty. Use tools such as Shuffle, Torch, or Hint to help when the next match is difficult to locate.

pages.title: Loop Survivors Zombie City
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Loop Survivors Zombie City puts you through repeating locations filled with zombies and mutants. Collect weapons, armor, and random perks to strengthen the hero during each cycle. Between runs, build the shelter and improve the city to prepare for another round of attacks.

pages.title: Halloween Stickman 2
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Halloween Stickman 2 lets you choose a response to Stickman's latest seasonal prank. Watch the animated setup, examine the available punishment choices, and click an option to see its outcome. Continue the Halloween story through the character's different mischief-and-revenge scenes.

pages.title: Kick the Noobik 3D
pages.creator: AY Indie
pages.description: Kick the Noobik 3D gives you a blocky character and a collection of tools for physics-driven mayhem. Select weapons, drag objects onto Noobik, or interact directly with taps and holds. Experiment with rockets, swords, machine guns, and other equipment to change the result.

pages.title: Save Stranding Fish
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Save Stranding Fish asks you to move stranded fish in an order that opens safe paths for them. Examine how the fish block one another and free the available ones first, working through the arrangement until the rescue is complete.

pages.title: Magic and Wizards Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Magic and Wizards Match joins Aurora on a gem-matching journey through a magical realm. Combine elemental gems to clear obstacles and produce stronger spells or boosters. Work through thousands of stages, tackle daily missions, and uncover treasures hidden behind the puzzle blockers.

pages.title: Missile Launch Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Missile Launch Master puts you in control of a guided projectile flying toward an island target. Drag to steer around hot-air balloons and helicopters while keeping the missile on course. Reach and strike the objective before the countdown expires to complete the flight.

pages.title: Idle Archer Tower Defense RPG
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Idle Archer Tower Defense RPG puts a lone archer in charge of defending a stronghold. Face the approaching monsters and keep the towering position protected from their attacks. Hold the defense as the archer fights the creatures threatening the realm.

pages.title: Home Pin 1
pages.creator: Gamee JSC
pages.description: Home Pin 1 follows Edward restoring an abandoned house while protecting his family. Pull bars in the right order to defeat villains, rescue his wife, and release money or decorations. Avoid dangerous combinations as you turn the house into a family home.

pages.title: Candy Match Saga 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Candy Match Saga 2 follows a small witch trying to escape a magical world through matching puzzles. Combine sweets and use power-ups to overcome the obstacles in each arrangement. Complete the successive match-three stages to continue the witch's journey out of the realm.

pages.title: Park Me
pages.creator: HolaStudio
pages.description: Park Me challenges you to clear cars from a crowded parking lot. Start with vehicles near the outside and inspect each car's exit direction before moving it. Open routes through the arrangement while keeping the departing cars from hitting barriers or other vehicles.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Free 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Free 2 offers untimed bubble shooting with the option to swap the loaded shot for the next one. Clear matching color groups and build the fireball meter through larger removals. Use the special fireball when ready to help open a difficult part of the arrangement.

pages.title: Puzzle Emoji
pages.creator: syderzone
pages.description: Puzzle Emoji asks you to connect emoji pictures that share a theme or relationship. Tap matching choices in separate columns or drag a line between them. Solve the full collection of pairings in the current puzzle to complete the level.

pages.title: Animal Jump
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Animal Jump puts a character into a survival race filled with obstacles and collectible gold. Steer around threats, use boosts, and work toward reaching the finish first. Spend the gold on improvements that help the hero perform better in the next race.

pages.title: Yummy Candy Factory
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Yummy Candy Factory lets you make sweets in flavors including strawberry, grape, apple, and pineapple. Choose a flavor, mix and boil the ingredients, then shape the candy. Work through the preparation steps to create a batch with your preferred appearance and taste.

pages.title: Match Tile 3D
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Match Tile 3D gives you a collection of three-dimensional objects to sort into matching trios. Select identical items and remove complete sets from the arrangement. Keep examining the remaining objects as you work toward clearing the current triple-matching puzzle.

pages.title: Shoot and Merge the numbers
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Shoot and Merge the numbers asks you to fire numbered blocks into chosen columns. Place a block beside an identical value so they combine into a larger number. Keep creating useful matches to increase the score and develop higher-valued pieces across the board.

pages.title: Monsters Attack Impostor Squad
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Monsters Attack Impostor Squad puts three small heroes against monsters and controlled soldiers. Switch characters to handle the fighting, shoot enemies, and activate special powers when useful. Guide the squad through the attack while facing threats inspired by familiar horror-game creatures.

pages.title: Birds Catcher
pages.creator: funky forest
pages.description: Birds Catcher gives you a special gun that launches nets rather than ordinary bullets. Aim at the birds crowding the sky and capture them to reduce the flock. Use the mouse or touch controls to direct the net-catching action at the airborne targets.

pages.title: City Siege 2. Resort Siege
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: City Siege 2. Resort Siege sends your troops to stop enemies occupying a beach resort. Select a unit, move it through the level, and aim with the mouse to fire. Try units such as the Spy, Transport Copter, and Veteran against the attackers' stronger equipment.

pages.title: Noob Huggy Kissiy
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Noob Huggy Kissiy follows two characters trying to return home through a snowy forest. Move and double-jump past the route's dangers while watching for bees and slimes. Complete ten maps to guide Huggy and Kissiy through the cold jungle adventure.

pages.title: Cycling Hero
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Cycling Hero puts you in a bicycle race where contact can remove rivals. Steer through the competition and use the rear wheel to knock opposing cyclists aside. Keep riding ahead while choosing opportunities to disrupt the racers sharing the course.

pages.title: Police Escape
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Police Escape challenges you to outrun a policeman through an obstacle-filled route. Tap to jump and keep the runner clear of the barriers ahead. Collect acceleration items and protective shields to help the character continue the escape for longer.

pages.title: Solar System
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Solar System presents a question-and-answer activity about our planetary neighborhood. Examine each prompt and click the response you think is correct. Work through the solar-system questions to practice recognizing the information shown by the game's educational activities.

pages.title: Heroball Adventures
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Heroball Adventures sends a red ball after friends captured by a strange machine. Roll and jump through the stages, avoid obstacles, and free companions trapped along the route. Collect stars during the rescue journey to unlock additional balls for later adventures.

pages.title: Among Us Smash
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Among Us Smash turns crewmates into floating balloon targets. Pop the colored balloons while leaving blue ones intact, even when several overlap. Hitting three blue balloons ends the game, so each crowded group needs a careful tap.

pages.title: Rope Master
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Rope Master challenges you to break every cup by releasing a suspended ball. Cut its ropes in the right order and at the right moment, using the resulting swing or fall to reach the cups in each level.

pages.title: Assault Zone
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Assault Zone puts you inside enemy territory in a first-person shooting mission. Move through the area, aim at the guards and eliminate them before their return fire catches you. Watch your surroundings while lining up each shot.

pages.title: Knots Master 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Knots Master 3D presents tangled wires that need to be separated and connected correctly. Move their ends to work out the crossings, considering how each adjustment affects the other wires before settling on a clear arrangement.

pages.title: Easy Kids Coloring Bat
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Easy Kids Coloring Bat provides a collection of bat pictures to color. Choose an outline, select your colors and fill the image to create your own version. The pictures can also be printed for coloring with crayons.

pages.title: Animals Jigsaw Puzzle Tiger
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Animals Jigsaw Puzzle Tiger offers eight tiger pictures to rebuild from scattered pieces. Drag each piece into its proper place, choosing a 2-by-3, 3-by-4 or 4-by-6 layout to change the size and complexity of the puzzle.

pages.title: Quad Bike Traffic Racing Mania
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Quad Bike Traffic Racing Mania takes ATV racing onto highways crowded with traffic. Steer your quad through the road and find gaps between vehicles as you keep moving at speed. Careful positioning matters when the available space narrows.

pages.title: Love Rescue
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Love Rescue is a pin-removal puzzle about bringing a boy and girl together. Pull the pins in a useful sequence to open his route, accounting for the obstacles and monsters that could stop the rescue.

pages.title: Vegetables Match 3 Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Vegetables Match 3 Deluxe asks you to arrange matching vegetables into groups of at least three. Work toward each level's target while using helpful items such as hourglasses and bombs. Later boards make those goals harder to reach.

pages.title: Dungeon.ro
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Dungeon.ro combines overhead shooting with character levels and upgrades. Move through its dungeon battles, aim at enemies and dash when you need to reposition. Developing your character accompanies the immediate challenge of surviving each encounter.

pages.title: Impossible Little Dash
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Impossible Little Dash sends a small character past spikes and obstacles that appear from the sides. Click or tap to change its movement, watching for the next hazard and timing each adjustment to keep the run going.

pages.title: Corana Ayurveda Remedy
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Corana Ayurveda Remedy presents a sequence of virtual food and herbal-preparation activities. Select the indicated objects, cut ingredients and mix them in the kitchen scenes. Follow the game's prompts to complete each preparation step.

pages.title: Happy Armadillo Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Happy Armadillo Coloring includes eight armadillo pictures for creating your own colored scenes. Pick an image and apply whichever colors you prefer. When the picture is finished, use the camera button to download your version.

pages.title: Control 2 Cars
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Control 2 Cars divides your attention between two vehicles on the road. Guide both cars around obstacles at the same time, keeping track of each one's route so that a safe move on one side does not distract from the other.

pages.title: Draw Pixels Heroes Face
pages.creator: DiHits
pages.description: Draw Pixels Heroes Face asks you to reproduce a reference image one colored square at a time. Compare the example with your drawing, select the correct colors and place them in the corresponding positions to rebuild the hero's face.

pages.title: Build Your Robot
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Build Your Robot gives you a selection of parts for assembling a custom machine. Choose components and combine them into your own robot, experimenting with different arrangements to decide how its finished body should look.

pages.title: Desert Road
pages.creator: Play.works
pages.description: Desert Road follows a bouncing ball along an endless desert route. Steer its hops around obstacles and into targets, adjusting its sideways movement as the road continues. Keep the ball's landing position in mind before each bounce.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Kittens
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle Kittens contains sixteen kitten images to assemble from separate pieces. Drag the pieces together to restore each picture, using their edges and markings as guides. An eye button reveals the complete image when you need a reference.

pages.title: Microbes
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Microbes turns a single click into a spreading chain reaction. Select a microorganism to burst it into smaller projectiles that can strike the others. Choose the starting point carefully to make the reaction reach more of the field.

pages.title: Christmas Art 2019 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Christmas Art 2019 Puzzle offers six seasonal pictures with four puzzle sizes each. Reassemble an image using 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces, matching the scattered sections until the Christmas artwork is complete.

pages.title: Worms District
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Worms District sends your growing snake through a field of fast food. Guide it toward cakes, burgers, pizza and other snacks while staying clear of larger snakes. Gathering food makes your snake longer but leaves more body to manage.

pages.title: Divide
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Divide challenges you to shrink a playing field without letting its moving ball strike your divider. Drag the divider into position and choose a safe moment to make the cut. Watch the ball's route before committing to a placement.

pages.title: Flick Golf Star
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Flick Golf Star turns golf shots into target challenges. Drag to launch a ball and aim it through the hoop, adjusting the shot for the level's arrangement. Make the available balls count as you work toward completing each stage.

pages.title: Monster High Toralei Stripe Shopping Dressup
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Monster High Toralei Stripe Shopping Dressup lets you style the feline student with a new outfit. Choose clothes that suit Toralei's attitude and combine the wardrobe options into a finished look for the werecat.

pages.title: Fire Storm
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Fire Storm sends you into a city overrun by armed gangs. Complete combat objectives by shooting enemies and destroying their cars while keeping your fighter alive. Grenades, jumping and a time-slowing ability provide additional ways to handle the fighting.

pages.title: Crazy Maze
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Crazy Maze asks you to guide a black box through a maze to the green box. Find a connected route through the layout and steer along it to finish the stage. Reaching the goal opens the next maze.

pages.title: Fun Animals Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fun Animals Jigsaw provides twelve animal pictures with three piece counts to choose from. Rebuild your selected image with 25, 49 or 100 pieces, fitting the sections together until the complete animal scene takes shape.

pages.title: Foot Doctor
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Foot Doctor puts you in a cartoon clinic caring for patients' feet. Select the appropriate tools and drag them into place to carry out treatments, including closing wounds. Complete the care activities before moving to another patient.

pages.title: Funny Pong
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Funny Pong challenges you to keep a bouncing ball inside a brick cage. Tap to close the opening at the right moment so the ball cannot escape, and collect coins for extra points while maintaining the rally.

pages.title: Hoppy Rushy
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Hoppy Rushy follows a runner hopping through buildings and across their floors. Time each tap to reach the next surface safely, judging the gaps as the route changes. A misplaced jump sends the character falling away from the course.

pages.title: Football Genius Challenge
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Football Genius Challenge uses footballs as the pieces in a chain-reaction puzzle. Burst a ball to set off nearby balls and work toward clearing the whole arrangement. Consider how the reaction will spread before choosing where to begin.

pages.title: Horse Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Horse Coloring Book gives you horse outlines to fill with your chosen colors. Select a picture and a brush color, then paint the different areas to create your own version of the horse scene.

pages.title: Doll Creator Halloween Theme
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Doll Creator Halloween Theme lets you design a doll and give it a Halloween costume. Combine clothing with hairstyles, eye styles and colors, then add face paint or a mask to finish the character's seasonal appearance.

pages.title: Color Zap
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Color Zap sends colored balls toward a ring that must match them. Tap the appropriate color box to change the ring before the next ball arrives. Keep watching the incoming colors and switch at the right moment.

pages.title: Fill The Gap
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Fill The Gap asks you to fit block shapes into empty spaces and complete rows for points. Clearing multiple rows together earns a bonus. Plan your placements around the space that remains as the endless board fills up.

pages.title: I am The Ninja II
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: I am The Ninja II sends a ninja through platforms lined with spikes. Run, jump, slide and fly through the hazards while following the master's course. Completing the level set unlocks an endless mode for chasing higher scores.

pages.title: Car Crossing
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Car Crossing puts you in charge of vehicles approaching a busy crossing. Click a car or truck to speed it up and separate its path from the others. Keep traffic flowing safely, because a collision ends the game.

pages.title: Olaf The Viking Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Olaf The Viking Game follows Olaf across icy landscapes, mountains and volcanic terrain. Tap to jump over sharp spikes while gathering coins for points. Keep judging the next landing to make the journey last as long as possible.

pages.title: Master Checkers
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Master Checkers brings the board game to a digital board with selectable pieces. Choose a piece and move it to play your turn, considering the positions of both sides as you work through the match.

pages.title: 3 Pandas HTML5
pages.creator: FlashTeam
pages.description: 3 Pandas HTML5 follows three pandas trying to get home through a dangerous jungle. Interact with each scene and use the pandas' different special actions together to overcome obstacles and get past the people blocking their journey.

pages.title: Bubble Ocean
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Bubble Ocean is a bubble shooter built around making groups of at least three matching bubbles. Aim the next bubble toward a useful cluster and fire, looking for placements that connect the matching colors on the board.
